submission.reason: Exploration of data/explore.csv showed that after adjusting for region, none of the ten candidate exposures had a robust direct effect on species_richness. All single-exposure OLS models with region fixed effects were non-significant (smallest p ~0.15 for temperature_c), partial within-region correlations were all |r|<0.08, and nonlinear (spline/quadratic) and interaction checks revealed no consistent signal. temperature_c was the strongest linear candidate (coef ~0.19, p~0.15), so it was chosen for the single confirmatory test. The pre-registered confirmatory OLS on held-out data (outcome ~ temperature_c + region) gave estimate -0.041, SE 0.129, p=0.749, not significant at alpha=0.05. The hypothesis is therefore not confirmed.
